full_judgment: 3. The applications were opposed by the present petitioners who were respondent Nos. 2 and 1 respectively in the company matter by filling written objection and affidavit-in-opposition respectively (as available from the record) mainly on the ground that the respective matter abated against the decreased petitioner No. 1 as the application for substitution of his heirs in his place was not filed within 90(ninety) days pursuant to the provisions of Order XXII, rule 3 of the Code Civil Procedure and article 176 of the Limitation Act and that the application did not reveal sufficient cause for the failure to substitute the legal heirs of deceased petitioner No. 1 within time.
